summary: Propose a new entry under the assignment's rhn, explicitly provisional in root identification. The only attested form is rhəlle in I Preterit; the Infectum is not attested and has not been invented.

The preceding msalamle u abro baynoṯayye and maḥatle rahin, graw anchor the event in giving the son as a hostage. rhəlle sidayye then leaves/pledges him with the same party; sidayye is the recipient/location phrase, and the son is contextually recoverable.

rhən-le > rhəlle through n+l assimilation is a plausible analysis, not an observed base form. The dictionary association with rahin does not establish a verified etymology; no etymological source or unattested stem is asserted.

Read-only lookup confirms no rhn entry. The form lookup gives only consonantal suggestions, not an actual rhəlle example. Existing rḥl is II mraḥele/mraḥəl ‘abreisen’, and does not match either the unprefixed form or this hostage frame.
The cognate nominal phrase maḥatle rahin is contextual evidence, not another finite rhn occurrence or an independent attestation. No additional sense or Detransitive is supported.
Confirm the exact printed h and rhəlle: does it represent rhn with n+l assimilation, another verb ‘leave’, or a source error? The hostage meaning is firmer than the root attribution.
What is the Infectum and the unassimilated Preterit base of this verb in the speaker's dialect? Neither can be recovered securely from this one token.
